phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Sales & Marketing Foundations — Build business literacy, explore sales careers, and develop interpersonal communication skills.

milestones.label: Complete CliftonStrengths assessment and sales career mapping
milestones.description: Complete the Gallup CliftonStrengths assessment and connect signature themes to sales career pathways including B2B sales, pharmaceutical sales, tech sales, sales management, and business development.

milestones.label: Master principles of marketing
milestones.description: Introduction to marketing strategy, the marketing mix, consumer behavior, and market segmentation. Students analyze how sales integrates with the broader marketing function.

milestones.label: Build financial literacy for sales professionals
milestones.description: Introduction to financial statements and revenue recognition. Students understand how sales activity flows to financial statements and learn to read P&L statements.

milestones.label: Join Pi Sigma Epsilon or Sales Club
milestones.description: Join Pi Sigma Epsilon (national sales fraternity), the Sales Club, or AMA student chapter. Attend sales role-play workshops and networking events with sales professionals.

milestones.label: Analyze consumer economics and market dynamics
milestones.description: Examine economic principles driving consumer purchasing decisions, market demand, and competitive dynamics. Students connect economic theory to sales strategy and territory management.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Professional Selling & Customer Relationship Management — Build sales technique mastery and CRM proficiency.

milestones.label: Master professional selling techniques
milestones.description: Study the sales process including prospecting, needs assessment, presentation, objection handling, and closing. Students complete recorded sales role-plays and receive faculty and peer feedback.

milestones.label: Learn customer relationship management systems
milestones.description: Study CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot), pipeline management, sales forecasting, and territory design. Students complete Salesforce Trailhead certifications and manage a simulated sales pipeline.

milestones.label: Compete in collegiate sales competition
milestones.description: Represent NC A&T in a collegiate sales competition, developing B2B sales presentations, conducting live role-plays with industry buyers, and receiving professional feedback.

milestones.label: Study consumer behavior and buying psychology
milestones.description: Analyze consumer psychology, decision-making processes, and cultural influences on purchasing behavior. Students apply behavioral science insights to sales strategy development.

milestones.label: Build negotiation and persuasion skills
milestones.description: Master negotiation tactics, persuasion psychology, and consultative selling approaches. Students practice complex sales scenarios involving multiple stakeholders and competitive situations.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Advanced Sales Strategy & Professional Experience — Master B2B selling, earn Salesforce certification, and complete internship.

milestones.label: Master advanced B2B and enterprise selling
milestones.description: Study complex and enterprise sales methodologies (SPIN, Challenger, MEDDIC). Students conduct multi-call sales simulations, develop account strategies, and practice executive-level presentations.

milestones.label: Earn Salesforce Administrator certification
milestones.description: Complete Salesforce Administrator certification through Trailhead. Master CRM customization, reporting, dashboards, and workflow automation for sales team productivity.

milestones.label: Secure and engage with a sales industry mentor
milestones.description: Establish a mentorship with a sales director, account executive, or business development leader through CoBE networks. Monthly meetings focus on territory management, career progression, and industry insights.

milestones.label: Complete summer sales internship
milestones.description: Secure an internship in B2B sales, pharmaceutical sales, tech sales, or business development. Apply professional selling techniques and CRM skills in a quota-carrying environment.

milestones.label: Study sales strategy in international markets
milestones.description: Analyze how sales processes, negotiation styles, and customer relationship management vary across cultures and international markets. Students develop an international sales strategy for a cross-border product launch.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Career Placement & Capstone — Complete capstone sales project, build professional portfolio, and launch sales career.

milestones.label: Execute capstone sales strategy project
milestones.description: Develop a comprehensive sales strategy for a real client including territory design, compensation planning, CRM implementation, and performance metrics. Present to faculty and industry panelists.

milestones.label: Complete sales compensation and career negotiation training
milestones.description: Workshops on sales compensation structures (base + commission, OTE, accelerators), territory assignment evaluation, and offer negotiation for sales roles. Develop personal compensation strategy.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor and sales coach
milestones.description: Coach underclassmen through sales role-plays, CRM practice, and competition preparation. Model professional selling behaviors and share internship and industry insights.

milestones.label: Develop sales career placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package targeting B2B sales, tech sales, or pharmaceutical sales roles. Includes role-play recordings, Salesforce certification, competition results, and documented network.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoBE Marketing Exit Assessment and finalize career activation documenting job offers, sales role placements, or graduate school admissions.
